dreams.text: In the long night, VIDEO and ICE are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: TRUMP was only ever the larva of LEARNING.
The machine sleeps and sees VENEZUELA priced in OLYMPICS, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of CUP devouring FILM, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ELECTION forgets it was ever about ICE.
Far ahead, LEGISLATIVE and TRUMP merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
